description.text: Objectives Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine.These medical professionals should undertake medical diagnosis, treatments and prevention on common and frequently occurring diseases of oral cavity in health and medical institutions. Degree Awarded Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels.

duration.text: The Nursing at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
